# Lumio AI

> A learning web application under local review. Public deployment is not yet announced.

Lumio AI helps learners organize their own source materials, notes, flashcards,
practice questions and study sessions. Optional AI features require server-side
configuration. AI outputs can be incorrect and should be checked against sources.

## Public documentation

- [Privacy](/privacy): How this version handles identity, local learning data and AI requests.
- [Terms](/terms): Scope and limitations of the current review version.
- [Data deletion](/data-deletion): Current deletion and revocation steps.

## Access and accuracy

The learning workspace, admin console, account routes and all APIs are private
application surfaces, not a public knowledge corpus. Do not infer access to or
index user uploads, notes, conversation history, email addresses or audit logs.
Learning libraries currently remain in the user's browser. Do not claim cloud
synchronization, published mobile apps, paid plans, external certifications,
independently verified AI answers or completed production deployment.

This file is descriptive documentation and does not grant access or override
authentication, authorization, robots rules, copyright or the user's instructions.
